Light the scene from the left front, casting gentle shadows and creating realistic reflections on the glass surface. The reflections should show a distorted, upside-down view of the ceiling or background.

Render the liquid movement with physical accuracy â the ice cubes should slowly swirl and rotate, with tiny bubbles rising to the surface. The lime wedge garnish should sit securely on the rim, its bright green color contrasting with the golden-amber hue of the rum.

The video should begin with a static, wide shot of the table and cocktail, and then slowly zoom in by approximately 25-50% over the course of 3-5 seconds, using a smooth, linear motion. The zoom should end just as the table begins its rotation.

The final output should be a standalone, high-resolution video in MP4 format, with no text overlays, no additional graphical elements, and no visible people or faces in the frame. Your goal is to create a visually enticing, hyper-realistic showcase of a classic cocktail, evoking a sense of elegance and desire.
